# DEngine root build (SPEC §3.2, §3.4).
#
# Later tasks do not edit this file. They add sources in src/<mod>/CMakeLists.txt through
# de_add_module(), and new directories under third_party/, src/, tests/, tools/ and examples/
# are picked up automatically (see de_add_subdirectories() in cmake/DeModule.cmake).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)

project(dengine
    VERSION 0.1.0
    DESCRIPTION "DEngine C11 game engine"
    LANGUAGES C CXX)

# The Metal backend and the macOS platform layer are written in Objective-C (.m). Enabling the
# language here means those later sprints need no root edit.
if(APPLE)
    enable_language(OBJC)
endif()

set(DE_ROOT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" CACHE INTERNAL "DEngine source root")
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH "${DE_ROOT_DIR}/cmake")

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# Order matters: build types first (they set CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE and create de_config), then options
# (they read the build type), then compiler flags, then the module helpers.
include(DeBuildTypes)
include(DeOptions)
include(DeCompiler)
include(DeModule)
# Test helpers (de_add_test, de_add_fuzz_target) arrive with DENG-63. Included here, before any
# subdirectory, so third_party smoke tests and module tests can use them.
include(DeTesting OPTIONAL)

enable_testing()

add_subdirectory(third_party)
add_subdirectory(src)

if(DE_BUILD_TESTS)
    add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()

if(DE_BUILD_TOOLS)
    add_subdirectory(tools)
endif()

if(DE_BUILD_EXAMPLES)
    # examples/CMakeLists.txt (flat samples such as minimal_game) must not add its children:
    # every examples/<name>/CMakeLists.txt is added here.
    if(EXISTS "${DE_ROOT_DIR}/examples/CMakeLists.txt")
        add_subdirectory(examples)
    endif()
    de_add_subdirectories(DIR "${DE_ROOT_DIR}/examples")
endif()

if(DE_BUILD_DOCS AND EXISTS "${DE_ROOT_DIR}/docs/CMakeLists.txt")
    add_subdirectory(docs)
endif()

de_write_config_dump()
